business_problem: Liberty Energy needed to connect siloed finance, workforce, supply chain, and field-equipment data so it could optimize trucking and rail logistics, analyze profitability in real time, and keep operating control while scaling a high-growth energy services business that processes about 1 GB of equipment data per hour.
solution_summary: Liberty Energy standardized core business processes on Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, EPM, SCM, and HCM, then extended that foundation with Oracle Fusion Agentic Applications and an Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse on OCI. The lakehouse centralizes finance, operations, supply chain, and workforce data alongside petabyte-scale field information using OCI Object Storage, Oracle AI Data Catalog, and open Apache Iceberg tables that ingest data from AWS, Azure, MongoDB, Postgres, and Amazon databases. OCI GoldenGate and Oracle Data Integrator replicate data in near real time, while Oracle Analytics Cloud and Oracle Essbase expose field revenue, inventory, cost, and profitability metrics to decision-makers. Oracle APEX and Oracle Autonomous AI Database support low-code extensions, and Primavera tools add project planning and maintenance management. Together, the platform turns multicloud operational data into analytics and agentic automation across business functions.

data_flow: Finance, supply chain, workforce, and field-equipment data from Fusion applications plus AWS, Azure, MongoDB, Postgres, and Amazon data stores are ingested through OCI GoldenGate and Oracle Data Integrator into Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse and OCI Object Storage; Oracle Analytics Cloud and Essbase expose profitability and operations views, while APEX and agentic apps automate downstream business workflows.
